program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture
question: Can healthy persistence remain quiet while saving/recovery/read-only/corruption/persistence-failure states become explicit, truthful application status outside fiction, with exact prior-task return and without freezing a storage/recovery implementation?
inherited_law: Healthy persistence stays quiet; no permanent all-changes-saved/local-first footer is required.
Saving, recovery, corruption, read-only or persistence failure must have truthful semantic witnesses when relevant.
Persistence state must never be fictionalized as Character behavior, Stage action or causal Production history.
Back/Close/navigation must not silently discard work, repair corruption, confirm durability or mutate Production truth.
Exact storage, autosave, repair, fallback, conflict and lost-work semantics remain Product-defined.
Responsive status presentation must preserve semantic origin, task context and focus restoration.

design_result.healthy_rule: No intervention is needed and no permanent persistence chrome is required merely because persistence exists.
design_result.separation_rule: Persistence failure does not establish corruption; corruption/integrity concern remains independently represented.
design_result.fiction_boundary: Infrastructure state cannot become dialogue, silence, refusal, Character incapacity, Stage action or causal Production history.
design_result.recovery_flow: origin -> infrastructure exception -> truthful explanation -> recover_or_remain_unresolved -> exact prior-task/context/focus return when safe
design_result.rollback_rule: Application recovery does not imply fictional rewind, another Take, branch, rehearsal, consequence reversal or timeline rollback.
design_result.destructive_action_rule: Back, Close, dismissal or layout/theme changes cannot silently discard work, confirm durability, repair corruption or mutate Production truth.
design_result.responsive_rule: wide adjacent explanation -> medium overlay/substitution -> narrow sequential blocking status/recovery/restored task; semantic origin remains invariant
design_result.theme_parity: PASS - Light/Dark preserve the same persistence/infrastructure semantics

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP; exact self-contained HTML; no external resources

first_visual_pass_findings: The first narrow render overflowed because the long header stamp remained no-wrap at 390/320px.
The first state matrix combined corruption and persistence failure, which incorrectly suggested equivalence between integrity concern and failure to persist.
corrections: Allowed the narrow stamp/header to wrap and reran all viewport cases to zero overflow.
Separated persistence failure from corruption/integrity concern and expanded the state matrix to six witnesses.

non_authority: Exact autosave/save-point, durability, transactionality, local/cloud, backup, repair, conflict-resolution and data-loss semantics remain Product-defined.
Exact recovery actions, read-only policy, corruption validation and fallback behavior remain open.
Exact Scene/Take/branch/rehearsal/consequence semantics remain open and are not inferred from recovery UI.
Final labels, severity treatment, icons, dialogs, notifications, typography, palette, motion and native WinUI behavior remain open.
No Stage visual successor, runtime/package/Store authority or native accessibility-device proof is created.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail Production lifecycle utilities inside the frozen shell: reserve deliberate application/Production-scope routes for settings, portable import/export, provider configuration, diagnostics and recovery utilities without freezing Product/Phase-D commands or allowing infrastructure machinery to dominate ordinary creative work.
